name: El Zonte Village and Point Break
tagline: The original Bitcoin Beach and its famous wave
description: The heart of the action, where rustic guesthouses and cafes cluster around a world-class right-hand point break. This is the mellow core of the Bitcoin Beach community, laid-back and surf-focused, with steep dirt tracks leading down to the black sand and reliable waves.
pros: Excellent point break at your doorstep
cons: Steep, rough roads to the beach

name: River Mouth and Beach Area
tagline: Black sand, tide pools and sunset gatherings
description: The stretch where the river meets the Pacific, framed by rocky reefs, tide pools and dramatic black-sand beach. It is the scenic social hub for sunset drinks, beach walks and swimming when conditions allow, though currents near the river mouth demand respect and awareness.
pros: Central to beach bars and cafes
cons: Strong currents near the river mouth

name: El Tunco
tagline: The livelier surf-town hub of the coast
description: A short ride east, El Tunco is the coast's busiest surf town, packed with hostels, bars, restaurants and nightlife around its iconic rock formation. It draws a younger backpacker and party crowd and works well as a livelier base or a fun evening trip from quieter El Zonte.
bestFor: Nomads wanting more nightlife and amenities
pros: Wide choice of bars and restaurants
cons: Busier and less peaceful than El Zonte
Can feel touristy in high season

name: El Sunzal and La Libertad
tagline: Long-wave surf and the coast's working port town
description: El Sunzal offers a longer, mellower wave popular with longboarders and learners, sitting near the fishing port of La Libertad, the main service town on the Surf City coast. Together they provide markets, a seafood pier, banks and more amenities within easy reach of El Zonte.
vibe: Mixed surf and everyday local life
bestFor: Longboarders and those needing town services
pros: Long, forgiving wave at El Sunzal
Fresh seafood at the La Libertad pier
cons: La Libertad is more urban and less charming
